profile.headline: Vice President - Digital S/W Engineer Lead Analyst
profile.summary:
I’m a curious explorer of technology, driven by a passion to understand how it shapes everyday life. An engineering student at heart and a problem-solver by mindset, I’m constantly looking for ways to make technology more practical, efficient, and impactful for people.

Growing up during the rapid rise of digital transformation sparked my interest in understanding how computer systems work and how technology connects the world. This curiosity led me to pursue Computer Science, where I built a strong foundation in digital systems, application development, and real-time implementation.

Over time, I’ve developed a keen interest in areas such as software-defined systems, application development, cloud computing, data visualization, and network security. I enjoy exploring how these domains come together to power modern digital experiences.

What excites me most is taking a top-down approach—understanding complex technologies and simplifying them to create efficient, user-focused solutions that enhance everyday productivity.

I’m always learning, always building, and always looking for new ways to innovate.

Stay tuned to know more about my journey.

positions.title: Vice President - Digital Software Engineer Lead Analyst
Assistant Vice President - Digital Software Engineer Sr. Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Bootstrap · Angular · REST APIs · Node.js · Splunk · Microservices · ECMAScript · TypeScript · Jasmine Framework · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Front-End Development · Version Control · Communication · Unit Testing · Swagger API · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
●	Working on KP.ORG page and supporting to Middleware Platform.  
●	Experience in making Responsive Web Pages using Media Queries and Bootstrap.
●	Strong knowledge of software development life cycle, specifically Agile (scrum) methodology and adept in understanding user-requirements, code implementation, testing and code deployment in various environments. 
●	Extensive experience with JS frameworks like Angular 12+ and Node JS.
●	Hands on Experience on Angular CLI (Command line Interface), Bootstrap, CSS3, Angular Material. 
●	Manual Deployment script using CLI and Automated deployment using Jenkins and git. 
●	Experienced in Performance Tuning, Query Optimization, Client/Server Connectivity, and Database Consistency Checks using different Utilities. 
●	Developed code on strict cross-browser compatibility support for: IE8/9/10, Firefox, Chrome, and Safari.
●	Also Hands on Experience as a SharePoint Developer using PowerApps and creating custom applications.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Computer Science · Front-End Development · Version Control · Communication

positions.title: Sr. UI Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained custom HR applications within LinkedIn, supporting talent acquisition and employee lifecycle processes.
Built scalable and maintainable web applications using the Angular framework and the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
Designed and delivered internal tools including Letter Tool (offers, employment letters, notifications), New Hire Integration Portal, PerkUp, Wellness Portal, TA Roster, and Talent Portal.
Integrated and collaborated with key third-party HR systems such as Workday, Jobvite, SmartRecruiters, Cornerstone OnDemand, ServiceNow, Willis Towers Watson, ADP GlobalView, and RedCarpet (RedCat).
Partnered closely with ServiceNow teams for daily Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and operational support.
Contributed to agile development processes, ensuring rapid delivery of high-quality HR technology solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Front-End Development · ServiceNow · Version Control · Communication

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: 
•	Experience in developing Web Applications using predefine UI Component,Typescript, Angular(2/4/5/6) Bootstrap, JSON, SASS, LeSS.
•	Experience in working with Angular 2/4 modules, services, templates, directives, and Routing and dependency injection, and also shared data services… 
•	Expertise in Angular 2/4 framework and its ability to create simple and scalable code for SPA.
•	Worked extensively on Angular2/ 4, Typescript SPA domains.
•	Hands on Experience on Angular CLI (Command line Interface).
•	Used the new tags from HTML5 like section, article, header and footer.
•	Experience in making Responsive Web Pages using Media Queries and Bootstrap.
•	Strong knowledge of software development life cycle, specifically Agile (scrum) methodology and adept in understanding user-requirements, code implementation, testing and code deployment in various environments
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Front-End Development · Version Control

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities : 
Collaborated with Business Analysts to gather and translate requirements into functional web solutions.
Designed and developed responsive web applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and AngularJS.
Built dynamic, scalable UI components and screens aligned with business and technical specifications.
Implemented responsive design using Bootstrap, SASS, and media queries for cross-device compatibility.
Integrated front-end components with back-end systems using RESTful APIs, AJAX, and JSON.
Ensured cross-browser compatibility across IE, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.
Participated in full SDLC including development, testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.
Worked closely with back-end teams to enhance application performance and functionality.
Debugged and optimized applications using tools like Firebug and Batarang.

Environment: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, SASS, AJAX, JSON, Eclipse
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Front-End Development · Version Control
